Lets the BeamCast phone app navigate this TV like a remote control (move, select, go back, type). It does not collect or send personal data or what is on screen.
Could not open settings. Enable it manually in Settings › Accessibility › BeamCast Receiver. If that menu does not exist, turn on USB debugging in Developer options and come back to BeamCast.

To use your phone as this TV's remote, turn on "BeamCast Receiver" in Settings > Accessibility.

No Accessibility menu on your TV? Go to Settings > About, press "Build" 7 times, open Developer options and turn on "USB debugging". Come back to BeamCast and accept the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt with "Always allow": the remote turns on by itself.

This is only used to move focus and press buttons. No data is collected.
